about.title: About us
about.intro: Shenzhen Starlink Automation Co., Ltd. specialises in industrial automation system integration and engineering services. Around PLC commissioning, robot integration, electrical drawing design, lithium battery inspection and hot press equipment, we deliver one-stop projects for new-energy battery, 3C electronics and automotive parts manufacturers — from concept and electrical design to programming, on-site commissioning and ramp-up support.
about.intro2: Our core team comes from the automation equipment and system integration industry with over a decade of average experience. We are fluent in Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron, Inovance, Delta and Beckhoff control platforms, and in FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Epson and Universal Robots arms. We believe good automation is not about stacking equipment — it is about hitting process, cycle time and reliability targets at the same time.
